name: Rubescent-Drumlin
description: Cloud-architecture stacks to the horizon in every direction, ammonia cirrus above, sulfurous murk below. Great storm eyes stare up out of the depths, unhurried and permanent.

Downward the pressure builds into black liquid air; upward, the storms scream past at jet speeds. There is no calm layer to stand in, only depths that tolerate visitors briefly. The only confirmed life is microbial, a chemosynthetic film that glows faintly where the ground weeps warmth.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
